title: Mediator Pattern
description: Decouple components with a centralized mediator.

data.text:
**Mediator Pattern**

Defines an object that encapsulates how objects interact. Instead of classes referring to each other directly, they communicate through the mediator.
Think of an air traffic controller. Planes don't talk to each other — they all talk to the controller, who coordinates everything safely.
MediatR is the de facto mediator library for .NET. It implements the mediator pattern with requests, notifications, and pipelines.

items: Single Responsibility: handlers do one thing
Decoupling: handlers know nothing about each other
Pipeline behaviors: logging, validation, caching cross-cutting concerns
Testability: handlers are simple to unit test

data.title: CQRS Companion
data.text: Mediator is often used with CQRS to separate read and write operations cleanly.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Next, we'll explore CQRS for separating reads from writes.
